question: U10: a start with Flip X on. Wavy (the first shape), Divider on, Edit Settings, Flip X Axis, then View Layouts on a paragraph and picks 2, 0, 3, 4. Predictions pushed before the read. Blocks Probe, unsaved, one capture.
basis: CAP-U10DIVIDER.json: layouts with no divider of their own put the start's divider back; layouts 2 and 3 set soft corners and rounded with isFlipX false and stroke none (CAP-U10UNDO.json)
scored: 2 of 2 that could be read held (CAP-U10FLIP.json): pick 3 rounded with isFlipX false and stroke none, pick 4 wavy with isFlipX true, so the start had Flip X on. Not readable: the start, pick 2 and pick 0, whose section context still showed the state from before the Flip X press. It is rewritten only when the section redraws, as on a theme change, and picks 3 and 4 change the theme.
rescored: 4 of 4 now (CAP-U10FLIP3.json): pick 2 soft-corners with isFlipX false, and pick 0 after 2 wavy with isFlipX true, both held; pick 0 alone also wavy with isFlipX true, by the same rule. Read from the section's context after a second press labelled Divider, meant for the tab, switched the divider off: that redraws the section and rewrites the context (unsaved, left through Exit Without Saving). CAP-U10FLIP2.json: the drawn wavy edge has the same points with Flip X on and off, so the drawing in edit mode can't show it.
